mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 46 degrees. The moon is a Waning Gibbous, and the ISS will be visible tomorrow morning starting at 5:07 AM, rising over Verona High School and traveling toward Fitchburg. Overnight, we will drop to a low of 39 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona reminds everyone that winter street parking rules begin on November 20, requiring alternate-side parking to assist with snow removal. Additionally, please be aware the Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

We have plenty of fun on the horizon with Main Street Trick-or-Treat happening tomorrow at Hometown Junction Park, along with live music at Bailey's Run. Plus, the Dane County Farmers' Market returns to the Capitol Square this Friday.
In a noteworthy call from October 25, officers responded to a vehicle stopped at an intersection for 20 minutes, which resulted in the driver being arrested for O W I.
Culver's of Verona has wrapped up today's service, so we look forward to tomorrow's flavor, Chocolate Covered Strawberry, when the doors open again at 10 AM.
